headline: Gov’t infra spending finally picked up pace in September to P89.7B
summary: Government infrastructure spending rose 14 percent to P89.7 billion in September, ending over a year of straight contractions. The late rebound did little to support third-quarter economic growth, according to Department of Budget and Management data.
why: Public infrastructure spending is a major lever of government-led growth in the Philippines, and its pace feeds into GDP and fiscal execution.
